text_block_list.text:
One day, after having woven a magnificent 
heroic tale together with Zenno Rob Roy 
and captivating the crowd—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No. Just as I thought, no matter how much 
I search... it seems there are no legends 
about heroes connected to the hot spring 
we're heading to...

Even on the train heading to the hot 
springs won from the shopping district 
raffle, Zenno Rob Roy's interest remained 
fixed on "heroes" as usual.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Well, there are cases where the 
innkeeper tells you if you ask, or it's 
quietly written in a brochure, after 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So it hasn't been completely decided 
yet...! There's no need to get 
discouraged, it'll be all right...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, right now it's hot 
springs time, right!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Hot springs have existed in this world 
since ancient times as natural 
sanatoriums, and they are often spoken of 
in myths and legends."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Dian Cecht, the god of healing in Celtic 
mythology, is quite famous, isn't he? 
During the Second Battle of Mag Tuired—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, could the 'Fountain of Health' 
mentioned here actually be what they 
called a hot spring back then—?”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
By the way, in Celtic mythology, there are 
hot springs that appear in a much more 
definitive form, you see—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Ah, wah, hah...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...I-I'm sorry...! I just... got a little 
carried away...!"

At any rate, there's no doubt she's 
looking forward to the hot springs...!

Barely taking a moment to settle into the 
inn's room, I devoured the brochures and 
asked the staff, but—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
There really weren't any anecdotes after 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
However... we still have our last line of 
defense...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, have you ever seen it? The 
trivia panel on the bathhouse wall put 
there to pass the time...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Most of the contents explain the health 
benefits, but occasionally some describe 
the origins of the hot springs 
themselves...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The core of a hot spring inn is the 
bathhouse itself... In other words, this 
is the deepest part—the final dungeon."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out... In search of the lost 
legend—!
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —There was a panel in the bathhouse.

With Zenno Rob Roy this concerned about 
it, I'm starting to get curious too...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: This hot spring—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It turns out this works wonders for 
relieving fatigue, neuralgia, muscle 
soreness, and stiff shoulders...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Turns out there was no legend!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it is a little disappointing, but... 
How should I put it—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Searching for the legend was fun in 
itself, so... Even if we didn't find it, I 
feel like I gained something.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I've been so excited ever since last 
night...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes! ...Once again, thank you so 
much for bringing me along.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even if there's no legend of a hero... as 
long as I'm with Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I've always known that it'll become the 
greatest story...!

Seeing Zenno Rob Roy's smile brings back 
all our memories together up to now. Just 
as my eyes started to well with tears—
(Knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yes!

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me— Dinner will be ready in about 
thirty minutes. Please do not forget to 
prepare yourself.

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text: And also... umm...

The refined inn waitress shyly took out a 
signature board for an autograph.

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
"—Could I please have Lady Zenno Rob Roy's 
autograph here...?!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? Wh-Eh-Huh...!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure an autograph from someone 
like me is really okay...vell!?

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, of course. It is precisely 
because it's you, Lady Zenno Rob Roy, that 
I ask.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-Is it because... it's me?

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because you are the great 'Hero 
Zenno Rob Roy' who accomplished such a 
grand feat—

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
"The tale that that hero soothed her 
fatigue from the Twinkle Series in our hot 
spring... is a wonderful boon for an inn 
like ours with no deep history."

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
So if it wouldn't be a bother, by all 
means—!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...N-No way... Then that means, it's just 
like...!
choice_data_list:
A hero like you will become a legend of 
this hot spring.

A hero like you will become the legend of 
this hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I... I managed to make it this far, didn't 
I?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. May I borrow a 
pen...? I would love to give you my 
autograph...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Also, um. Is it alright if I only use 
half of the autograph board?

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text: Huh? I don't mind, but why...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I'd like you to sign your name right next 
to it, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because... the hero "Zenno Rob Roy" 
only exists because I have a Trainer like 
you, <username>-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Together, we make a single legend. 
...Because you were there. Because you 
were with me... I made it this far.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So... I want to sign it together. ...Is 
that alright?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thank you so much!

The autograph board signed with "Zenno Rob 
Roy" and "<username>" was proudly displayed in the 
ryokan's lobby.

Together, a single legend. I will surely 
never forget the smile on Zenno Rob Roy's 
face when she said that.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Zenno Rob Roy...
